annotations.title: A company's legal status in its register

description: The register's legal status of one company: value (active, no_end_recorded, in_restructuring, dissolution_recorded, in_liquidation, bankrupt, dissolved, deregistered), the register's own code and label, since (the date the source gives for it taking effect; null where it gives none), as_of (the date the source stated it) and availability (available, none_stated, not_collected, unavailable, not_in_warehouse). Status is collected for some register markets only (get_data_dictionary's company_attributes lists them); the others answer not_collected. no_end_recorded means the register records no end and no open proceeding; it is not a statement that the company is active. Inputs: ticker; as_of (the status on that day by the source's own dates; needs a licence key).

as_of.description: Status on this day, YYYY-MM-DD, by the source's own dates (needs a licence key)

name: get_company_status
